origin.summary: Workout 5 of the 2020 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A single-round chipper of muscle-ups, rowing calories, and wall-ball shots.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2020/5 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09; movements may be performed in any order, partitioned as desired
